title: FFmpeg Helper
changeSpeedTip: Change video playback speed (slower or faster)
convertWhisperTip: Convert audio to Whisper-compatible format (WAV, mono, 16kHz)
convertWhisperError: Failed to convert to Whisper format
missingFiles: Please select input file and output folder
outputPreviewDuplicate: File name exists — will save as duplicate ({{n}})
mergeVideosTip: Sequential concat: video 1 plays fully, then video 2, 3, 4… in list order. Normalizes resolution and audio automatically.
mergeVideoListEmpty: Add at least 2 video files to merge
mergeAudioTip: Add external audio to a video. Adjust original/external volume, sync offset, loop short audio, or replace the original track.
audioOffsetHint: Positive = delay external audio; negative = trim start of external audio
loopExternalAudioHint: Repeat external audio until video ends (for shorter tracks)
copyVideoStreamHint: Keep original video quality (faster). Turn off to re-encode video.
mergeAudioMissingFiles: Please select video, audio, and output folder
invalidAudioOffset: Audio offset must be between -3600 and 3600 seconds
mergeAudioError: Failed to merge audio into video
